<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

All fragments in any two joining structures with local left/right units agree in the unanchored incidence language. The coarse account is exact and reduced for that language yet can turn the same spent history’s impossible self-join into a possible one.

Canonical source: [JoiningRoles.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/JoiningRoles.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- HasUnits for the general collapse; the concrete case reuses budgetProcess admitted histories, trace_has_units and spend_cannot_self_join.

The example compares an actual fragment of the existing one-use process with its coarse code; the omission is fixed-input joining, not arbitrary ontological identity or a freely toggled predicate.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1 checks 43 new declarations and 213 inherited audits, 256 total; new 9 empty and 34 standard dependency lists, 7 with classical choice. Frozen source/logs bind to the receipt; no independent-agent acceptance.

Refutes the candidate inference that unanchored questions suffice for full joining, not the possibility of generative grounding. Local units are not proved universal; the collapse theorem needs no finiteness.
